name: @csbc-dev-examples/root
description: Orchestrator for the @csbc-dev/feature-flags examples. See CONVENTIONS.md.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install --no-save && npm --prefix react install --no-save && npm --prefix vue install --no-save && npm --prefix vanilla install --no-save
scripts.build:examples: npm --prefix react run build && npm --prefix vue run build && npm --prefix vanilla run build
scripts.build: npm run build:pkg && npm run build:shared && npm run build:examples
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
